reasons_for_supersession.detail: The calibration-closure lineage used by V1 could realize only 36 of 42 authenticated observation operators at 2,000 cells even though all 42 were feasible within source quotas. The smoke gate checked a qualification status string rather than realized occupancy.

V1 built a fragment stream but its final 100K authority did not require an independent recomputation of compressed fragment SHA-256 and per-barcode multiplicity reconciliation to the paired-multiome source.

V1 recommended PASS_TO_500K after measuring the 100K footprint, but no prospectively frozen 500K resource budget or compatibility rule existed. Positive 100K resource measurements do not establish 500K compatibility.

what_v1_can_still_support: a real provider-backed 100K execution occurred at the recorded source SHA
the historical run produced its recorded 100K population/QC/resource measurements
the historical run does not by itself authorize 500K or learned JEPA training
replacement_authority_requirements: exact-head 2K smoke with source-feasible realized operator occupancy
independent fragment-byte linkage receipt bound into readiness
100K result authority consuming the independent fragment-linkage receipt
separate 100K architecture qualification from 500K resource-promotion authority
